name: losha
description: Losha Valas, the Calabim vampire heroine: a pale woman with long flowing black hair, glowing red eyes and red lips, black spiked plate armour with red trim and a high red-lined collar, a long red-and-black skirt and a red cape trailing on the screen-left side, black armoured boots, and a dark steel curved sabre with a red crossguard in her LEFT hand
hands: the sabre stays in her left hand on the screen-right side and her right hand is an empty black-gauntleted hand resting on her hip on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the sabre is lifted up over the head with its tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the sabre cocked behind the head with its curved blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the curved blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: sabre arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the curved blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the curved blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the long black hair and red cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the sabre lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right hand flung out to the left, sabre arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the sabre dipping, the empty right hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, sabre arm flung up, the empty right hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the sabre lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the sabre's tip resting on the ground, the empty right hand hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the sabre slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the sabre lies on the ground at the lower-right; her long black hair and red cape spread under her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the long black hair and red cape settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the sabre on the ground beside her
